recipes.name: Mirage's Pork Chops inspired by Apex Legends
ingredients: double cut bone in pork chop
instructions: For Babish Version:
For the Glaze

Combine brown sugar, white wine vinegar, Dijon mustard, maple syrup, cloves, cinnamon, cayenne pepper, and pineapple juice in a bowl. - 50 g brown sugar - 20 ml white wine vinegar - 20 g Dijon mustard - 10 ml maple syrup - pinch of ground cloves - pinch of cinnamon - cayenne pepper - 15 ml hand squeezed pineapple juice
Transfer to a small saucepan and reduce over medium heat for 5-10 minutes until syrupy. - For the Glaze
For the Sweet Potato Puree
Peel and thinly slice sweet potatoes. Add them to a medium saucepan with ½ cup water and butter. - 2 medium sweet potatoes - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - ½ cup water
Cook over medium-high heat until shimmering, then reduce heat to medium-low. Cook until soft and falling apart (10-20). - 2 medium sweet potatoes - 6 tbsp unsalted butter

Allow mixture to cool then transfer to blender or food processor. Blend until smooth. Season with kosher salt, honey, and maple syrup to taste. Blend again until fully combined. - kosher salt - honey - maple syrup - For the Sweet Potato Puree
For the Pork Chop

Sous-Vide Method: Season the pork chop heavily with kosher salt and freshly ground pepper. Vacuum-seal and cook in 140°F sous-vide device for at least 1 hour. - double cut bone in pork chop - kosher salt - freshly ground pepper

Alternative Method: If not using sous-vide, season the pork chop and sear it in a preheated skillet over medium-high heat for 3-4 minutes per side until browned. Reduce heat to medium and cook until the internal temperature reaches 140°F, flipping as needed. - double cut bone in pork chop - kosher salt - freshly ground pepper - For the Pork Chop
Remove pork chop from sous vide (or skillet). If sous-vide, sear in a hot skillet until a brown crust forms on all sides. - double cut bone in pork chop - For the Pork Chop
Plate sweet potato puree, arrange sliced pork chop on top, and drizzle with glaze. Serve and enjoy! - For the Sweet Potato Puree - For the Pork Chop - For the Glaze
For Game Version:

Combine the Dijon mustard, honey, maple syrup, cinnamon, cloves, and cayenne pepper in a bowl. Mix thoroughly. - 80 g Dijon mustard - 100 g honey - 30 g maple syrup - 15 g ground cinnamon - 15 g ground cloves - cayenne pepper
Season pork chops with kosher salt and freshly ground pepper. - 2 inch bone in pork chops - freshly ground pepper - For the Pork Chop - kosher salt
Preheat a large stainless steel skillet with a few tablespoons of vegetable oil over medium-high heat. When smoking, add the pork chops. - vegetable oil - 2 inch bone in pork chops
Sear for 2-4 minutes until browned. Add the glaze and coat evenly. - 2 inch bone in pork chops - For the Glaze
Transfer the skillet to a preheated oven at 375°F. Cook for 10-12 minutes, flipping halfway through, until internal temperature reaches 140-145°F. - For the Pork Chop
Remove, let rest for 5 minutes and serve.
For Writer's Version:

Combine Dijon mustard, honey, maple syrup, pineapple juice, cinnamon, and cloves in a bowl. Mix well. - 90 ml Dijon mustard - 110 ml honey - 30 ml maple syrup - 15 ml hand squeezed pineapple juice - pinch of cinnamon - pinch of ground cloves
Score the fat cap on each pork chop with two shallow cuts to prevent curling. - 2 inch bone in pork chops
Season the chops with kosher salt, ground pepper, cayenne, and brown sugar. - kosher salt - freshly ground pepper - cayenne pepper - sprinkle of brown sugar
Preheat the skillet over medium-high heat. Add pork chops and sear for 2-4 minutes on one side. - 2 inch bone in pork chops
Pour glaze over the cops. Flip and coat both sides. - For the Glaze - For the Pork Chop
Transfer to a preheated oven 375°F and bake for 10-12 minutes, until the internal temperature reaches 145°F.
Let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
